title: Renegade Necromancer
wikitext:
{{ Quest infobox | id = 181 | name = Renegade Necromancer | map = [[Image:Renegade Necromancer map.jpg|218px]] | campaign = Prophecies | region = Northern Shiverpeaks | type = Secondary | profession = necromancer | nationality = Tyrian | given by = [[Necromancer Morgan]] | given at = [[Yak's Bend]] }} End the villainy of Verata, who is kidnapping Ascalon citizens to use in his experiments. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = prophecies | profession = necromancer }} ===Objectives=== * Find [[Verata]] in [[Traveler's Vale]] and put an end to his experiments. * Return to [[Necromancer Morgan]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 350 [[Experience]] * {{skill icon|Necrotic Traversal}} * {{skill icon|Defile Flesh}} * {{skill icon|Well of Blood}} ==Walkthrough== Verata is found surrounded by [[corpse]]s of [[Ascalonian Ranger]]s near the [[portal]] to [[Ascalon Foothills]]. You can fight or run past the [[Verata's Fiend]]s and [[Verata's Horror]]s to get to him. When you see him, he will use [[Animate Bone Fiend]] on a corpse of an [[Ascalonian Ranger]]. When you go near him, his dialogue occurs and he will go through the Ascalon Foothills portal. Return to Yak's Bend to get your reward. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]]s *{{n}} 14 (24) [[Verata the Necromancer]] *{{r}} 5 (20) Corpse of [[Ascalonian Ranger]] ===Foes=== *{{x}} 6 (23) [[Verata's Fiend]] *{{x}} 6 (23) [[Verata's Horror]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Necromancer Morgan :''"As you've no doubt heard, there have been a number of recent disappearances among the townsfolk. Thus far, we've assumed they fell victim to the [[Stone Summit]] or other local menaces. The truth, [[Grenth]] forgive us, is something much much {{sic|Two instances of 'much'}} worse. One of [[The Order|our Order]], a promising Necromancer named '''Verata''', has been experimenting with new ways to enhance and maintain summoned [[minion]]s. Normally this would be a good thing, however, in his lust for power Verata has been kidnapping [[Ascalon]] citizens for use in his experiments! He was also spotted waylaying travelers coming up into the [[Shiverpeak Mountains|mountains]] from Ascalon. We must stop him, quickly and discreetly, before anyone can link the disappearances with our Order.
Can you be of help in this situation?"'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I will stop Verata. | decline = That's no concern of mine. | ask = '''Verata''' must be stopped! And remember discretion in this matter is advised. He is near the entrance to the Ascalon Foothills in '''Traveler's Vale'''. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== '''Verata the Necromancer:''' ''"Great progress... Now, my minions, you will live beyond your normal span." '''Verata the Necromancer:''' ''"Who interrupts my experiments? You are a dog sent by the Order to hound me, no doubt? You will regret crossing me whelp! You have not heard the last of me!"'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Necromancer Morgan :''"Now that Verata knows that our Order is after him, he will be careful not to show his face. This was not the desired goal, but it is a result we can work with. You have done well under difficult circumstances, . Just as it is quick to punish those who violate our rules, our Order always rewards the faithful." ==Notes== *This quest can be completed by [[running]] to Verata, since it does not require you to kill any foes. *This quest can be completed at the same time as [[Shiverpeak Stragglers]] or [[Oswalt's Epitaph]]. **For Shiverpeak Stragglers, you simply go a bit to the east, and can easily lead them back along the path you cleared. **For Oswalt's Epitaph, travel to the Ascalon Foothills where his headstone is located. *If you are a combination of Necromancer and [[Warrior]], do this quest at the same time as [[Securing the Vale]]. Both will lead you to the area with Verata. *Once Verata has entered Ascalon Foothills, the [[Bone Fiend]]s he created will remain in Traveler's Vale and become hostile.
